source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue extending LeanFrontier after synchronizing their fork with upstream. The accepted DescartesCurvatureAction module already supplied four indexed integral-linear Vieta reflections, preservation of the Descartes quadratic form, and an involution theorem at the LinearMap level. The project roadmap explicitly identifies a clean matrix/group action as the prerequisite for later arithmetic work on integral Apollonian orbits. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT therefore selected an independent algebraic stage-6 endpoint that does not depend on the still-validating geometric branch chain: bundle each accepted curvature reflection as a LinearEquiv, define the subgroup of integral curvature-lattice automorphisms generated by the four reflections, prove each generator squares to one, and prove by subgroup-closure induction that every group element preserves the Descartes form and hence integral Descartes quadruples. The human did not author or materially edit the Lean text. No claim of new mathematics is made. After the first receiver run accepted the proofs but rejected three elaborated entrypoint statements for exceeding the 65,536-byte normalized-statement budget, GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT preserved the same construction and proofs while moving the large subgroup/coercion formulas behind named Prop definitions and exposing compact wrapper theorems.
